content.text: I'm 10 screens into a very long table. I'll skim the rest quickly, the way Yarden would.

I gave up on this one and didn't pick a track. I sort of know which way I'd go, but I wouldn't act on it from this page.

What stuck with me is the big returns: 26.39% "3 שנים" on a "עוקב מדדים - גמיש" track (I think it was אנליסט), 25.86% on מיטב's "עוקב מדדי מניות", and 24.04% on a "מניות" track at the very top. The S&P tracks I came for are all around 13%. The fees all look the same, 0.5–0.7%, which sounds like nothing, so they didn't help me choose. There are over 140 tracks and they all look alike. The page doesn't recommend anything, so I'd close it and maybe ask someone at work which company they use.

**How it went:**
- **Top of the page:** I read the heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות". The "קופת גמל להשקעה 143" button was already picked, so I was in the right place. I ignored the orange box ("נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו…") and the line about the numbers.
- **The table:** I scrolled fast and stopped only on the big percent numbers and the company names in the grey bars: מור, אנליסט, מיטב, אלטשולר שחם, ילין לפידות, כלל.
- **The first company:** I never saw its name. The table starts with a bunch of rows and no company name on top, and those rows had the cheapest fees. That annoyed me.
- **Screens 12–14:** I skipped them. By screen 10 I was bored. I jumped to the bottom and only saw the last few rows ("חדש").
- **Things I skipped:** the small text at the bottom, the "חוקים וכללים" link, and the "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link.

**Where I got stuck:**
- **The returns:** each row has two numbers, "3 שנים" and "5 שנים". I'm not sure if 24% is per year or for the whole 3 years. The header says "שנתית ממוצעת" but it's tiny.
- **"פחות מ־3 שנים":** a lot of rows, including most S&P ones, show this instead of a number. So there was nothing to compare on.
- **"עוד לא דווח":** this sits in the fee column next to a little orange warning icon. It scared me off those rows.

**Words I didn't get:** "ההפקדות" (as a second fee next to "מהחיסכון"), "מט"ח", "אג"ח", "גמיש", "כספי (שקלי)", "קופה" and its numbers, "חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח". I also didn't get the round yellow and green charts. My guess is yellow means foreign stuff.
